cohort: 46 monoamniotic twin pregnancies (92 fetuses) managed between 1992 and 2018 in a level-3 university hospital maternity unit in France
finding: This study found a high risk of fetal and neonatal death in monoamniotic twins, with congenital abnormalities and unexpected fetal deaths accounting for the majority of mortality.
mod_finding: Vaginal delivery of monoamniotic twins appears safe, and delivery for uncomplicated cases should be considered around 33 weeks of gestation, but not later than 35 weeks.
